name: captionforge-monorepo
description: CaptionForge: arquitectura distribuida (API Gateway NestJS + AI Worker Python + Redis/BullMQ + PostgreSQL + S3).

scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres redis s3 && docker compose run --rm --no-deps pg-roles && docker compose run --rm --no-deps s3-init
scripts.web:check: npm run check -w @captionforge/web && python apps/web/scripts/gen-languages.py --check && node apps/web/scripts/gen-themes.mjs --check
scripts.compose:check: docker compose config --quiet && docker compose --profile app config --quiet
